Explain how a VPN works in simple words
11:19 PM

A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and another computer on the internet. Everything you send goes into the tunnel scrambled, so your Wi-Fi owner or internet company can't read it.

The VPN computer then visits websites for you. Sites see its address instead of yours, so your location and identity are less visible. The catch is that the VPN company can see your traffic instead, so pick one you trust.

It helps on public Wi-Fi and for privacy from your internet company. It doesn't make you anonymous, and it won't protect you if you sign in to accounts that already know who you are.
